div.div:
Why phishing dies
attacker's proxy site = wrong origin
signature is bound to rp.id
→ relayed assertion fails verification
TOTP: forwarded digits still work — passkeys don't

div.div:
Key concepts
discoverable — key stores user handle → usernameless
synced — roams via iCloud/Google keychain
device-bound — YubiKey-style, higher assurance
signCount — clone detector; regression = copied key
uv vs up — biometric/PIN vs. mere tap
